formula: m=median(eligible prior-date same-hour Wh); d=MAD; L=m-max(3*1.4826*d,10Wh,0.5*m). If m<20Wh -> null low_reference_energy; if L<=0 -> null no_positive_lower_threshold; otherwise point is low iff 0<=energy<L. No arbitrary negative/clamped threshold is used.
duration: 6 consecutive assessable low observations (3600s interval energy, 3000s measurement-label span); short cases retained as misses
context: 7 previous source-labelled calendar dates, >=3 dates and >=18 cadence-eligible same-hour points; no current day. Freeze24 distinct hourly profiles before first candidate, use the next hour own frozen profile even across midnight. Missing/unusable next hour -> null with reason, reset. Gap breaks candidate and excludes cadence-violating value from reference eligibility.
calendar: No workday, occupancy or holiday model; regular nonwork can trigger review despite legitimate usage. Weekday control explicitly tests this limitation without changing policy.
matching: Episodes built from complete per-method tri-state series before masks; false/null/cadence gaps break episodes. One event per independent case; credit only onset inside inclusive first..last modified labels; no overlap-only credit, no post-event grace. Rebuild union episodes, never sum component detections.
comparison: Primary own-available onset matches, all targets retained; per-point/event/full-stream coverage, common-ready-onset diagnostic; unions reconstructed from full tri-state decisions with provenance. Telemetry excluded. Report new18 and known6 separately, never pool as independent holdout.
preservation: Frozen v2/source hashes and original known-six Parquet compared only for regression verification; scores are recalculated fresh on modified/raw pairs. Save old outputs unchanged. Batch low wrapper and direct streaming process must exactly match for all cases.
contributions: Per cohort per event: all3 individual hit booleans, component-only and overlap counts; recompute both OR hit sets, added and lost vs residual and vs residual_high. Pair new-crossing only if raw flag explicitly false; unknown separate.

timing.warmup: 7 dates from midnight before start; load raw records/artifacts once before timing; prime V2+low state once and prime StreamDetector once. Restore deep-copied state outside timers, share immutable bundle.
scopes: rules_only: V2 + residual flag from the same precomputed causal stream + union, vs that and low
full_scoring: existing StreamDetector (all3 scores+RF forecast) + V2 + union, vs same and low
timing.boundary: Each per-record timer starts before processing, ends after rule(s)/ML/union decisions are formed; total timer spans identical144 record loop. No loading, state cloning, warmup, disk IO or serialization in timed loop. Include validation/feature/state/decision costs. No clock synchronization across processes needed.
timing.statistics: Per repetition/variant p50,p95 per-record ms, loop total ms; no pooling as independent records. Separate per-low-rule compute sample; paired deltas described as local overhead not universal guarantee.
timing.environment: Exact existing CPU image; cpus1 memory2g threads1 networknone; capture platform, CPU visibility/cgroup, libraries, image ID and hashes. No Kafka/performance campaign.

limits: Same previously studied historical house and viewed period
Synthetic targets are not verified physical failures
No parameter/scenario changes after results; all32 cases retained
Existing local trusted artifact differs from original archived Stage4 binary
